references.name: dashboard
references.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity buildable desktop web app screen reference for Spectacles, a personal concert journal. 1536x1024 landscape composition, crisp large readable real UI text. Consistent design world: warm ivory #f7f7f2 main background, near black #1d211e, electric chartreuse #d5f76a accents, gray-sage #eceee7 borders, muted olive secondary text, understated lavender for past events. Clean refined grotesk body and compact bold display sans, precise typography, generous 36px gutters, 16px panel radii only purposeful frames. Left sidebar 216px ivory with black square abstract soundwave mark and wordmark Spectacles; navigation Dashboard, Concerts, Calendar, Venue map, Setlists, selected item soft lime. Bottom sidebar 'Demo workspace' then 'Saved in this browser'. Flat open layouts, few thin borders, no nested boxes. Main header tiny breadcrumb and top-right outlined search icon + circular avatar 'J'. No gradients, no fake jargon, no decorative tiny pills, no browser device chrome. Small laptop readability. Primary button dark with lime small plus icon. A tasteful original concert photo where requested, never stock-photo watermarks. Signature motifs: vertical rhythm lines, off-grid editorial layout, layered image frames, clean product panels. Motion implied restrained float-up and smooth accordion expansion. This is a working product not a landing page. Dashboard overview: eyebrow 'YOUR PERSONAL ENCORE', headline 'Your life, live.' supporting 'The nights you never want to forget.' right primary '+ Add concert'. Four compact unboxed stats in one horizontal strip, thin vertical separators: 24 Concerts, 18 Artists, 8 Venues, 326 Songs. Hero below wide dark concert photograph frame, crowd silhouettes and lime stage lights at right with strong black gradient left; white headline 'Arctic Monkeys', label 'UP NEXT', metadata 'Nov 06, 2026 · Movistar Arena', small outlined white 'View concert' button. At right of photo large lime '15' white small 'DAYS TO GO'. Below hero two-column area: left 'Coming up' with airy list of two concerts, date blocks, artist/title and venue, small arrows; right open pale lavender setlist feature 'Still ringing in your ears.' 'Revisit your last setlist' with tiny music icon and stacked song lines. Clear top nav and calm app composition. Do not include map or heatmap this screen.

asset: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide banner background photograph for a personal concert journal web app. Original editorial concert photography, anonymous indie rock band silhouettes on stage, crowd with raised hands filling lower third, slender vertical warm chartreuse-yellow light bars on stage, hazy smoke, dramatic near-black shadows, real film grain subtle and natural, premium music magazine energy. Landscape 3:1 composition if possible. Keep left half almost black with faint silhouettes, bright olive-lime lighting and stage performers on right, darkest lower edges for readable overlaid app text. No text, no logos, no watermark, no artist likeness or name, no UI. No purple neon, no illustration.
